name: Pure x Lover -Ane to Osananajimi to H na Kankei-
original_name: PURE×LOVER -姉と幼なじみとHなカンケイ-
source:
The protagonist is just a normal high school student living in a small town. However, something finally worth celebrating happens to him just before summer vacation: he had sex for the first time with two girls at the same time. The first girl is his older sister, Hasumi, while the other one is his childhood friend, Shizuno, who is the same age as him.

After receiving confessions from the two almost at the same time, the protagonist wondered for a while what to do -- until, a certain desire awoke within him, and he decided to go out with both of them. That desire is... sexually training the girls!

The blood-related older sister, who is refined and kind but shy. "I'd like make her into a pervy girl who loves sex."
The childhood friend of the same age, who has tsundere tendencies and is stubborn. "Likewise, I'd like to make her into a pervy girl who finds sex pleasant."

With his girlfriends, he wants to have sex in all kinds of different ways. Thus, he decided it would be for the best to go out with the two of them at the same time.

So, what kind of results will the protagonist yield with his two girlfriends he intends to sexually train into sex-loving girls?

[From [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=802401]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主角只是一个生活在小镇上的普通高中生。然而，就在暑假前夕，终于发生了一件值得庆祝的事情：他第一次同时与两个女孩发生性关系。第一个女孩是他的姐姐莲实，另一个女孩是他的青梅竹马静野，与他同龄。

几乎同时收到两人的告白后，主角一时间犹豫着该怎么办——直到，他内心升起某种欲望，决定和两人一起出去。那个愿望就是……对女孩进行性训练！

有血缘关系的姐姐，儒雅善良，但害羞。“我想让她成为一个热爱性的变态女孩。”
同龄青梅竹马，有傲慢倾向，性格固执。“同样，我也想把她打造成一个性快感的变态女孩。”

他想和他的女朋友以各种不同的方式发生性行为。所以，他决定，还是两个人同时出去比较好。

那么，主角和他打算将两个女友培养成性爱女孩，会产生怎样的结果呢？
